sources.title: GitHub - ChaitanyaNarva/image-similarity-model
sources.snippet: Model training to find N similar images. Finding Nearest neighbors and taking N nearest points as similar images given on a query image. Prediction Algorithm: Step-1: taking either filename or url and converting that image into image array. Step-2: Using that array finding the feature from the intermediate layers of the trained autoencoder model.
